description: Defines the LinkMetricsCollectionTask class for managing link metrics collection, including handling CMDU messages, scheduling reports, and managing link/neighbor metrics within the prplMesh project.

classes.name: LinkMetricsCollectionTask
classes.description: Manages collection and reporting of link metrics, handling CMDU messages, scheduling periodic reports, and maintaining link/neighbor metrics.

methods.name: handle_cmdu
methods.description: Processes incoming CMDU messages related to link metrics.

methods.name: work
methods.description: Performs periodic work tasks for link metrics collection.

methods.name: handle_event
methods.description: Handles internal events such as reset or policy updates.

methods.name: send_ap_metric_query_message
methods.description: Sends AP metrics query messages to specified BSSIDs.

methods.name: add_link_metrics_tlv
methods.description: Adds link metrics TLVs to response messages.

methods.name: add_radio_metrics_tlv
methods.description: Adds radio metrics TLV to the CMDU.

methods.name: add_assoc_sta_mld_config_report
methods.description: Adds associated station MLD configuration reports.

methods.name: create_link_metrics_collector
methods.description: Creates a link metrics collector based on media type.

methods.name: get_neighbor_links
methods.description: Retrieves list of neighbor links from topology database.

methods.name: ap_metrics_reporting_cb
methods.description: Callback for periodic AP metrics reporting.

methods.name: handle_metric_reporting_policy_updated_event
methods.description: Schedules or cancels periodic reporting based on policy.

methods.name: beacon_metrics_query_cb
methods.description: Callback for scheduled beacon metrics queries.
